_comment: NOT a loadable rule file, on purpose. This is what a policy document written by a LATER release of the gate looks like to this one: a schema_version this binary does not speak, plus constructs that do not exist yet (a top-level key, a matcher kind, a group operator, a matcher field). Loading it must fail as RulesFromNewerSchema and exit 78 — NOT as a syntax error, which is how a newer file would otherwise take enforcement down silently. Deliberately absent from hookctl's RULE_FILES: it is not supposed to pass selftest.

rules.name: no-unsandboxed-exec
rules.reason: A rule from a future release, using matchers this binary has never heard of.

tests.rationale: a field that does not exist yet
